lighting_shading.note: Warm sunlit bus body with soft gradients and glossy highlights.

value_contrast.note: Saturated red bus pops against blue sky and gray road.

color_palette.note: Red bus against blue sky, with yellow wheel hubs as accent.

composition_hierarchy.note: Bus dominates frame; background buildings and clouds stay secondary.

shape_proportions.note: Rounded, chunky toy-like bus with simplified windows and details.

viewpoint_depth.note: Low three-quarter front view with strong perspective down the street.

edges_linework.note: Shapes defined by shading, not outlines; soft clean edges.

surface_finish.note: Smooth glossy paint, clean surfaces, stylised animated-film look.

rhythm_staging.note: Repeated seats and windows give rhythm; bus angled toward viewer.
